title: Catalogue archive manifest
description: Shape of the catalogue-manifest.json that `agentbundle catalogue package` writes into a catalogue archive. This schema describes shape only. A manifest that is valid against it is neither archive verification (the archive's bytes, digests and members are checked by `agentbundle catalogue verify`) nor evidence of who published the archive. Origin is established only by `catalogue verify --sha256-file` with a sidecar, or by a signature, obtained through a separately authenticated channel. Objects stay open: extra keys are allowed. The writer also emits keys this schema does not type because the verifier does not check them: source_revision, minimum_agentbundle_version, catalogue_name, catalogue_display_name and marketplace_digest (each may be null or a string), adapter_contract_version and pack_schema_version.

schema.description: Manifest schema version, 1 or 2. The package's validator rejects an integer-valued number such as 1.0 that standard JSON Schema validators and `catalogue verify` accept.
